data.one_liner: Generate short, unique, decryptable YouTube-like hashes from numbers.
data.what_it_does: Ported from JavaScript, this library encodes unsigned integers into short unique strings and decodes them back. It allows specifying minimum hash lengths and avoids basic English curse words in generated hashes.
use_when: You want to hide sequential database IDs in URLs or public places
You need to encrypt and decrypt IDs on the fly without storing them
avoid_when: You need cryptographically secure hashing for passwords or sensitive security tokens
You are working with negative integers
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and desktop
Allows encoding multiple integers at once
weaknesses: Only supports integers greater than or equal to zero
